parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/RadioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift` within the `Playback` package. The structural similarity (Jaccard 0.727) between `playCallsUnderlyingPlayer` (line 22) and `radioPlayerStopCallsUnderlyingPlayer` (line 37) reflects the natural parallel shape of XCTest-style behavioral test methods that each exercise a distinct operation (play vs. stop) on the underlying player. Merging or abstracting these test methods would obscure the intent of each individual test case and couple distinct behavioral assertions, reducing test clarity without any production-code benefit.
